test_Sigmoid_forward: test the Sigmoid bijector forward pass against jax.nn.sigmoid on random input arrays
test_Sigmoid_inverse: test the Sigmoid bijector inverse pass recovers original input after forward transformation
test_Sigmoid_forward_log_det_jacobian: test the Sigmoid bijector forward log determinant jacobian against numerical gradient computation
test_Sigmoid_inverse_log_det_jacobian: test the Sigmoid bijector inverse log det jacobian equals negative of forward log det jacobian
test_Sigmoid_stability: test the Sigmoid bijector numerical stability against TFP Sigmoid on extreme input values
